SELECT t.dev_team_id, t.owner_user_id, t.name, t.description, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dev_team_members m WHERE m.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id AND m.start_date <= NOW() AND (m.end_date IS NULL OR m.end_date > NOW())) AS members_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lambdas b WHERE b.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id) AS lambdas_count FROM dev_teams t
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_team_members um WHERE um.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id AND um.user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY t.dev_team_id

SELECT t.dev_team_id, t.owner_user_id, t.name, t.description, m.user_id, m.start_date, m.end_date, b.lambda_id, b.name AS lambda_name, b.description AS lambda_description FROM dev_teams t LEFT OUTER JOIN dev_team_members m ON m.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id LEFT OUTER JOIN lambdas b ON b.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id WHERE t.dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} ORDER BY m.user_id, b.lambda_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_team_members WHERE dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND start_date <= NOW() AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date > NOW()))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_teams (owner_user_id, name, description) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{description})
INSERT INTO dev_team_members (dev_team_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{devTeamId}, #{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dev_team_members WHERE dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
